previous_state.description: ZQK native agent commands (like execute, sync-loop, and swarm-init) should natively support automatic workspace isolation (e.g., --workspace branch or --workspace share). This should automatically provision a git worktree and feature branch for the agent task, run the execution in that isolated environment, and handle merging back to the integration branch. This mirrors Antigravity's invoke_subagent Workspace parameter and eliminates the need for users/orchestrators to write manual bash glue scripts to prevent git index.lock collisions during concurrent swarm execution.
previous_state.title: Native Agent Workspace Isolation
